summary: Rename default local sockets to fractal.sock and fractal-client.sock

replay.detail: No event or replication replay change.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema change.

compatibility.detail: Default Rust readers resolve Fractal-first with legacy fallback at every connection attempt, including outage retries; daemon aliases keep older readers working. Explicit configured paths stay exact, including a legacy socket that is also the state discovery target. State directories, environment variables, protocol identifiers and service names remain unchanged.

downtime.detail: No planned downtime; the daemon serves both default socket names during the migration. If only the shorter legacy filename fits the platform Unix socket address limit, it serves that name alone with a path-length diagnostic; default clients skip the overlong name. Daemon alias probes retain addressable short parent-symlink spellings even when the canonical directory exceeds that limit, and fail closed if the parent directory identity changes across a probe. Rust client and Fabric adapter discovery probes never block on a full listen backlog: pending connections count as available, while macOS backlog refusals retain the primary when both aliases refuse; transport deadlines still bound the actual request.

manual.detail: No action for default discovery. Explicit carrier paths remain explicit; choose fractal-client.sock for new paired gateway configurations.

recovery.detail: Legacy daemon readers remain supported through temporary socket aliases; default readers discover older daemons through legacy sockets. Seat attachment materialization retains discovery identity when adding actor authority, including legacy-only and published custom endpoints.
